// Generated by SEMAPRAX Public Generic Consumer v1
// (semaprax.public-generic-consumer-metadata.v1).
// Compiler-generated deterministic output; do not edit.
//
// This reads public generic *metadata*. It is not a calling convention: it
// receives no SEMAPRAX value, allocates none, frees none, and links against
// nothing. The declarations below show the substituted field tree in C++; they
// define no layout, no ownership transfer, and no ABI.
#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace spx_pg {

constexpr std::size_t kMaxDepth = 64;
constexpr std::size_t kMaxNodes = 4096;
constexpr std::size_t kMaxFields = 8;
constexpr std::size_t kMaxRecords = 8192;
constexpr std::size_t kMaxBytes = 1048576;
constexpr std::size_t kNone = static_cast<std::size_t>(-1);

__DECLARATIONS__
constexpr std::array<std::uint8_t, __EXPECTED_LEN__> kExpected = {
__EXPECTED__
};

constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 9> kScalars = {
    "bytes", "usize", "bool", "char", "i64", "i32", "f32", "f64", "u8"};

// A decimal count, without a leading zero, terminated by `stop`.
std::size_t Decimal(std::span<const std::uint8_t> bytes, std::size_t at,
                    std::uint8_t stop, std::size_t &out) {
    const std::size_t start = at;
    std::size_t value = 0;
    while (at < bytes.size() && bytes[at] >= '0' && bytes[at] <= '9') {
        const std::size_t digit = static_cast<std::size_t>(bytes[at] - '0');
        if (value > (kNone - digit) / 10u) {
            return kNone;
        }
        value = value * 10u + digit;
        at++;
    }
    if (at == start || (at - start > 1 && bytes[start] == '0')) {
        return kNone;
    }
    if (at >= bytes.size() || bytes[at] != stop) {
        return kNone;
    }
    out = value;
    return at + 1;
}

// One canonical grammar term. Returns the offset after it, or kNone.
std::size_t Term(std::span<const std::uint8_t> bytes, std::size_t at,
                 std::size_t depth, std::size_t &nodes) {
    if (depth > kMaxDepth || at >= bytes.size()) {
        return kNone;
    }
    if (++nodes > kMaxNodes) {
        return kNone;
    }
    if (bytes[at] == '@') {
        std::size_t identity = 0;
        at = Decimal(bytes, at + 1, ':', identity);
        if (at == kNone || identity > bytes.size() - at) {
            return kNone;
        }
        for (std::size_t index = 0; index < identity; index++) {
            if (bytes[at + index] == 0) {
                return kNone;
            }
        }
        at += identity;
        if (at >= bytes.size() || bytes[at] != '<') {
            return kNone;
        }
        at++;
        if (at < bytes.size() && bytes[at] == '>') {
            return at + 1;
        }
        while (true) {
            at = Term(bytes, at, depth + 1, nodes);
            if (at == kNone || at >= bytes.size()) {
                return kNone;
            }
            if (bytes[at] == ',') {
                at++;
                continue;
            }
            if (bytes[at] == '>') {
                return at + 1;
            }
            return kNone;
        }
    }
    for (const std::string_view scalar : kScalars) {
        if (bytes.size() - at >= scalar.size() &&
            std::memcmp(bytes.data() + at, scalar.data(), scalar.size()) == 0) {
            return at + scalar.size();
        }
    }
    return kNone;
}

bool Equals(std::span<const std::uint8_t> bytes, std::size_t at,
            std::size_t width, std::string_view text) {
    return width == text.size() &&
           std::memcmp(bytes.data() + at, text.data(), width) == 0;
}

// Empty when the document is the expected one; otherwise a closed reason.
std::optional<std::string_view> Verify(std::span<const std::uint8_t> bytes) {
    constexpr std::string_view magic = "spxpgcm1;";
    if (bytes.size() > kMaxBytes || bytes.size() < magic.size() ||
        std::memcmp(bytes.data(), magic.data(), magic.size()) != 0) {
        return "malformed";
    }
    std::size_t at = magic.size();
    std::size_t records = 0;
    while (at < bytes.size()) {
        if (bytes[at] != '|') {
            return "malformed";
        }
        std::size_t count = 0;
        at = Decimal(bytes, at + 1, ';', count);
        if (at == kNone || count == 0 || count > kMaxFields) {
            return "malformed";
        }
        std::array<std::size_t, kMaxFields> starts = {};
        std::array<std::size_t, kMaxFields> widths = {};
        for (std::size_t index = 0; index < count; index++) {
            std::size_t width = 0;
            at = Decimal(bytes, at, ':', width);
            if (at == kNone || width > bytes.size() - at) {
                return "malformed";
            }
            for (std::size_t byte = 0; byte < width; byte++) {
                if (bytes[at + byte] == 0) {
                    return "malformed";
                }
            }
            starts[index] = at;
            widths[index] = width;
            at += width;
            if (at >= bytes.size() || bytes[at] != ';') {
                return "malformed";
            }
            at++;
        }
        std::size_t term = kMaxFields;
        if (widths[0] == 1) {
            const std::uint8_t kind = bytes[starts[0]];
            const bool data3 = count == 6 && Equals(bytes, starts[3], widths[3], "data");
            const bool data2 = count == 4 && Equals(bytes, starts[2], widths[2], "data");
            if (kind == 'P' && data3) {
                term = 5;
            } else if (kind == 'R' && data2) {
                term = 3;
            } else if (kind == 'I' && count == 4) {
                term = 1;
            } else if (kind == 'A' && count == 4) {
                term = 3;
            } else if (kind == 'F' && count == 5) {
                term = 4;
            }
        }
        if (term != kMaxFields) {
            std::size_t nodes = 0;
            const std::size_t end = starts[term] + widths[term];
            if (Term(bytes.subspan(0, end), starts[term], 0, nodes) != end) {
                return "term";
            }
        }
        records++;
        if (records > kMaxRecords) {
            return "malformed";
        }
    }
    if (records == 0) {
        return "malformed";
    }
    if (bytes.size() != kExpected.size() ||
        std::memcmp(bytes.data(), kExpected.data(), bytes.size()) != 0) {
        return "mismatch";
    }
    return std::nullopt;
}

int Report(std::optional<std::string_view> refusal) {
    if (refusal.has_value()) {
        std::printf("refused:%.*s\n", static_cast<int>(refusal->size()),
                    refusal->data());
        return 3;
    }
    std::printf("ok\n");
    return 0;
}

}  // namespace spx_pg

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc > 2) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "usage: consumer [metadata-file]\n");
        return 2;
    }
    if (argc == 1) {
        return spx_pg::Report(spx_pg::Verify(spx_pg::kExpected));
    }
    std::FILE *handle = std::fopen(argv[1], "rb");
    if (handle == nullptr) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "cannot open %s\n", argv[1]);
        return 2;
    }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> buffer(spx_pg::kMaxBytes + 1);
    const std::size_t len = std::fread(buffer.data(), 1, buffer.size(), handle);
    const int failed = std::ferror(handle);
    (void)std::fclose(handle);
    if (failed != 0) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "cannot read %s\n", argv[1]);
        return 2;
    }
    return spx_pg::Report(
        spx_pg::Verify(std::span<const std::uint8_t>(buffer.data(), len)));
}
